_note: Found rebuilding a SvelteKit app: a `<div>` left open inside `{#if}` makes the compiler's parse() throw at `{/if}` (block_unexpected_close). svelte-check --tsgo reported nothing and exit 0, while `vite build` and default svelte-check 4.7.8 both failed on it. The TSGO-ENHANCEMENT reports the parse error as default svelte-check does. Ok.svelte keeps its TypeScript error: a rejected sibling must not hide it.
